defects_found.description: Reported PICK wrong-choice rate on UNSOLVED problems is 0.72, but the artifact value is 0.60. The paper's own d=+0.24 is inconsistent with 0.72-0.36=0.36; 0.60-0.36 gives 0.24.
Paper states a single CLI version 2.1.317 for all subject calls. C3, the confirmatory study, ran on 2.1.318; only S1 and C2 ran on 2.1.317.

defects_found.location: Sec 2 Related work, characterization of wang2025llms
defects_found.description: The paper attributes to Wang et al. specific findings: isolated true/false verification accepts incorrect options, that verification is related to choice, and that models still choose when a no-answer option is offered. The citation evidence records only the least-incorrect-option claim, from a search snippet with the pages blocked. The detailed priority and novelty-boundary claims are unsupported.

defects_found.location: Abstract and Conclusion, H3 cross-model verification
defects_found.description: Text says sonnet verification 'removed none of the inflation' and that the forced pick is also the one the other model is most likely to pass. H3 was inconclusive (d=+0.02, CI [-0.04,+0.07]), which cannot show that no inflation is removed. The mirror analysis for sonnet's picks (same-minus-cross +0.044, one-sided p=0.0486) is not reported.
Paper says subjects are only haiku and sonnet. An amendment adds gemma-4-e4b as a descriptive C3 subject (20 problems). It is not mentioned, so the run is not disclosed.

Abstract says the sonnet repeat showed 'the same two confirmed effects'. Sonnet's primary interaction was b=-0.02 (null), and the strata are defined by haiku's competence, not sonnet's. The effect on haiku-UNSOLVED problems does not show sonnet is beyond its own competence there.
